Institutional and Operational Strengthening of the Customs Administration

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo es aumentar la recaudacin aduanera mediante la mejora de los procesos, la implementacin de controles aduaneros y tecnologas que contribuyan a facilitar el comercio y disminuir la defraudacin fiscal. Los objetivos especficos de desarrollo son: (i) incrementar la eficiencia de la gestin operativa de la AAH; y (ii) mejorar los controles, la automatizacin y el uso de las tecnologas para disminuir la defraudacin fiscal.

The general objective of development is to increase customs revenue by improving processes, implementing customs controls and technologies that help facilitate trade and reduce customs fraud. The specific development objectives are: (i) to increase the efficiency of the AAH's operational management; and (ii) improve controls, automation, and the use of technology to reduce customs fraud.
